name: Handshake Briefcase
description: A handshake with a briefcase marks a professional agreement: a signed deal, a new job, a partnership, or a recruiter win. It is work, not a personal truce.
meaning: The handshake says an agreement was reached. The briefcase puts that agreement in an office, a contract, or a career move. Friends making up after a fight can use the handshake alone. 🤝💼 means someone got the job, the client, or the signature.
seoDescription: What does 🤝💼 mean? It means a professional deal or new job, a handshake that belongs to work rather than a personal truce.

longForm.overview:
The handshake emoji already means a deal, an agreement, or two people deciding to stop fighting. Put a briefcase next to it and the fight reading drops out. 🤝💼 is for the professional version: an offer accepted, a contract initialed, a partner brought on, a client who finally said yes. People paste it in group chats when the news is allowed to be public, and in smaller threads when they want three colleagues to know the signature happened.

The briefcase does the narrowing. Without it, "we 🤝" between siblings can mean the argument is over. With it, recipients look for a job title, a company, or a scope of work. That is why the pair shows up in LinkedIn-style announcements, founder chats, and family threads about a new role. It is a poor fit for a favor between friends. Borrowing a truck does not need a briefcase, and adding one makes a casual yes look like a term sheet.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
New hires send 🤝💼 on the day the offer arrives. Freelancers send it when a proposal converts. Teammates send it when a negotiation that ate a month finally closes. The pair is the announcement, often followed by the actual detail in the next sentence: the team, the start date, the client name if it can be shared.

Recruiters and managers sometimes send it to the candidate as congratulations. In that direction it is warm and a little corporate, which matches the briefcase. A string of hearts would feel like the wrong office.
longForm.whenNotToUse:
Skip 🤝💼 for a layoff, a rejected offer, or a deal that fell through. Both halves look like success, and the mismatch is cruel. Skip it for a handshake you refused.

Also skip it when the agreement is personal. A couple deciding to try again, or friends ending a cold war, want the handshake without the luggage from the office. The briefcase makes witnesses assume a career announcement and then hunt for a job that is not there.
longForm.howToReply:
Congratulations is the whole job of the reply, plus one specific question if you know them well enough: start date, team, how they feel. Matching 🤝💼 back works in a work chat. In a family chat, words land better than a second briefcase.

If you are the client or the hiring side, confirm the next step. "Welcome" plus the onboarding detail beats a vague celebration. If the news is a deal you were not supposed to hear about yet, do not forward the message just to spread the emoji.

faqs.question: What does 🤝💼 mean?
faqs.answer: 🤝💼 means a work agreement: a job offer, a signed contract, or a partnership. The handshake is the yes. The briefcase says the yes belongs to business.

faqs.question: Is 🤝💼 the same as a plain handshake emoji?
faqs.answer: No. A handshake alone can be a truce between friends. The briefcase pulls it into an office, a client, or a career move.

faqs.question: What does 🤝💼 mean from a recruiter?
faqs.answer: From a recruiter it is congratulations on an offer or a step that closed. Treat it as good news about the process, then read the sentence for which step.

faqs.question: Can I send 🤝💼 about a side project with a friend?
faqs.answer: Only if you mean it as a real working agreement. For a casual favor, the briefcase overstates the moment and makes it look like a contract.

conversationExamples.message: retainer is signed 🤝💼 kicking off Monday
conversationExamples.interpretation: A deal closed. Congratulate them and note the start if it affects your team.
Career news shared off-platform. A real congratulations beats a joke about corporate life.
Family announcement of a new role. Warmth first. Questions about salary can wait until they offer them.

conversationExamples.message: interview went so well we basically 🤝💼
conversationExamples.interpretation: They are excited about work, not proposing a relationship deal. Ask how the conversation went.
A public-facing partnership. React to the news. Do not ask for private terms in the group thread.
